activeAlerts.headline: 🌐 Global Corporate Spreads Compressed at 345 bps
activeAlerts.body: Global High Yield risk premiums trade near the 20th historical percentile. Ample alternative private credit liquidity ($1.7T) buffers corporate debt rollover across the US, Europe, and Asia.

activeAlerts.headline: 🛡️ US High Yield OAS Tightly Anchored at 318 bps
activeAlerts.body: Over 51% of the US corporate bond market resides in BBB tier; current narrow spreads denote minimal forced-selling downgrade risk into junk status.

activeAlerts.headline: 🏦 Global Commercial Bank Underwriting Standards Stabilizing
activeAlerts.body: US SLOOS (+2.1%) and Eurozone BLS (+3.4%) confirm commercial bank lending standards have normalized following the 2023 regional banking shocks.
